description: Append-only compact index of continuous workflow simulation session records. Raw compact evidence remains immutable; post-hoc integrity assessments may exclude records from objective use without rewriting raw metrics or artifacts.
append_policy: Add one immutable workflow_session record per executed baseline or treatment session. Never reuse a session ID or overwrite its compact evidence. A reusable baseline-pool identity is the frozen protocol fingerprint plus replicate, not execution date; the fingerprint binds fixture snapshot, task/verifier bytes, baseline substrate, runtime/model condition, and isolation policy. Completed workflow-simulation reproduction records must use sequential one-task-at-a-time prompt delivery, lazy future-prompt materialization, controller-only verifier assets, verifier integrity hashes, and seed-origin concealment. Create comparisons only after reviewed baseline and treatment records for the same pool exist. Supersede rather than delete historical results. A post-hoc integrity assessment may change status or objective eligibility only when the raw metrics/artifacts are preserved and the reason/evidence are recorded.

baseline_pool.identity_policy: frozen-protocol-and-replicate; execution date is metadata only

task_sequence.reset_policy: reset source checkout, profile home, tool state, indexes, caches, generated config, and agent home before the session; preserve source/tool/agent state while re-rooting model-facing Git metadata before each task

leakage_controls.model_writable_surface: target repository plus isolated model-output directory
remaining_limitations: Task semantics and verifier names may still be searchable if the model intentionally uses external network access.
Full prevention requires fixtures built from pre-fix bases plus hidden verifier tests rather than production-code reverse patches.

persist_between_tasks: repository source working tree; controller re-roots model-facing Git metadata before each task
memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

cumulative_token_usage.pricing_basis: not computed; Codex-reported token volume, not billing-weighted cost

software_quality.acceptance_reclassification: All five behavioral task verifiers passed; the original aggregate schema assertion was non-causal and contradicted a later intended task behavior.

state_observations.useful_state_reuse_notes: Single persistent Codex thread and source/tool/agent state across one lazily seeded task at a time.

artifacts.final_diff_basis: ordered per-task deltas relative to each concealed stage root
